patch_description: Replace the exponential-weighted moving average with an adaptive Kalman filter (online, zero structural lag) cascaded with a light double-exponential (Holt) smoother and a slope-gated reversal suppression step. The Kalman filter adaptively estimates local signal and slope, and its innovation-based noise estimate tunes the smoothing strength: strong smoothing in noisy flat regions (fewer false reversals, fewer slope changes), light smoothing when a genuine trend is detected (low lag error, good tracking). This directly targets all four objectives simultaneously and is O(n) so efficiency stays high.
